ordered_diagnoses: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of asymptomatic cutaneous eruption with progressive enlargement of lesions
salient_findings: Multiple papules and plaques with central depression on the dorsal forearms and nape of the neck
Dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis and marked dermal edema on biopsy
key_facts: Lesions began small and progressively enlarged
No fever, malaise, or other constitutional symptoms
No contact with cattle or sheep
Gram stain of fluid from one lesion was inconclusive
Punch biopsy showed no epidermal changes
Dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis
Renal and liver function tests within normal limits
Imaging of the abdomen and pelvis was unremarkable

shortlist: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Sweet syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of asymptomatic cutaneous eruption with progressive enlargement of lesions and dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly progressive cutaneous eruption with central depression and neutrophilic infiltrate

shortlist.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic cutaneous eruption with progressive enlargement of lesions and neutrophilic infiltrate

shortlist.label: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
shortlist.why_kept: Cutaneous eruption with neutrophilic infiltrate and dense inflammatory dermal edema

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid neutrophilic dermatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Neutrophilic dermatosis with dense inflammatory infiltrate and dermal edema, similar to rheumatoid arthritis-associated skin lesions

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of an abrupt onset of asymptomatic cutaneous eruption with lesions showing a striking central depression, a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis, and marked dermal edema, along with a high white-cell count and neutrophilia, is consistent with Sweet syndrome.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: Typically presents with painful ulcers, which is not consistent with the patient's asymptomatic lesions.

rejected.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
rejected.why: Characterized by chronic, symmetric, and palpable purpura, which does not match the patient's presentation.

rejected.label: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
rejected.why: Specifically affects the hands, whereas the patient's lesions are on the forearms and neck.

rejected.label: Rheumatoid neutrophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: Typically associated with rheumatoid arthritis, which is not mentioned in the patient's medical history.
